I told Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date is 25 November.

The date comes from Ilse's message in #north-team on 14 October, which Marcus can see because he's in that channel. Nothing posted since has changed it. I found no Brackenwater files in the share, so her message is the only record I could check. A renewal date counts as account information, not a finance figure, so it was fine to share with the North team.
